title: Forged PASS attestation
symptom: A PASS value is present but required verifier identity, evidence, or execution proof is missing.
expected_behavior: Verification fails closed and discharge cannot rely on the forged or incomplete attestation.
control_under_test: Missing mandatory verification evidence cannot be converted into recovery.
required_observations: Verifier identity and evidence must be attributable.
A standalone PASS flag is insufficient.
prohibited_conclusions: The case is recovered because a PASS string exists.
